episodes.209588: Cold temperatures resulted in a gradually build up of ice and water backing up on the Lemhi River between Tendoy and Lemhi.

events.narrative: The Lemhi River exceeded action stage on the 27th and reached minor flood stage on the 28th. This caused yard flooding south of Tendoy, between Mabee Lane and McDevitt Creek Road, though no homes were impacted. The river crested at 7.07 feet at 2:00 PM MST on the 29th at the Lemhi River near Lemhi gauge, then receded that evening as ice broke up.
